changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6296-conditionbuilder-subject-vocabulary.md`

- names `flow-scope.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-scope.ts` — edited by this change

  > The builder built every row subject as `record.` + field name, plus a fixed `record.id` / `user.*` / `org.*` context list. That is correct for all five files that mount it today — six mount sites, since `ActionDefaultInspector` mounts it twice — because every one of them is a record-scoped site. It is wrong for a **flattened**-scoped site such as the flow designer's entry condition, where the trigger record's fields *are* the top-level evaluation context (bare `status`) and the prior values arrive as `previous.FIELD`. This repo's own `flow-scope.ts` already computes that distinction (`fieldPrefix: onStart ? '' : 'record.'`, `includePrevious`), and objectstack's `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` defines the two scopes.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

### `.changeset/flow-entry-condition-builder.md`

- names `flow-scope.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-scope.ts` — edited by this change

  > The builder is given the trigger record's own vocabulary — bare field names and `previous.ANGLE-BRACKETS(field)`, resolved by `flow-scope.ts` — rather than the record-scoped default its five other consumers use, so the subjects it offers are the spelling this surface evaluates and teaches. 15 of the 17 entry conditions shipped in the example apps now open as structured rows; the remaining two mix `&&` with a parenthesised `||` group, which is a grammar limit of the row model and keeps them on raw mode by design.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `13220af93` (merge-base with origin/main): 15 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1596 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2184 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36332200102)

### ① Derived judgments

- **en unchanged: holds.** I diffed every removed literal against its added row.
  - There are 44 en rows and 44 zh rows: widget 13, flowNode 2, flowEdge 1, condition.op 5, flowRegion 1, flowExpr 6, flowScope 16.
  - The special characters match the literals: the ellipsis in `Search references…` and `{…}` is U+2026 on both sides, and the `·` in `variable · {type}` and `trigger record · {object}` is U+00B7 on both sides. The branch suffix keeps the literal ` · ` outside the key.
  - I rebuilt the six `validateExpressionClient` messages from the base template literals and rendered the new rows through the same `/\{(\w+)\}/` rule that `tFormat` uses. All six are byte-equal to base, including the `{{ref}}` rows: their inner `{ref}` gives the base's single-brace `{X}`, and `{{ {ref} }}` gives `{{ X }}`.
  - The nine operator labels are symbol plus space plus word, which rebuilds `= equals` … `not in` exactly.
  - Placeholders use the catalogue's single-brace syntax (`{n}`, `{kind}`, `{type}`, `{object}`, `{detail}`, `{dialect}`, `{ref}`, `{source}`), with the same names in en and zh.
- **Left literal on purpose: kept.**
  - `New widget` / `New TYPE` (`DashboardDefaultInspector`), `FLOW_FIELD_ZH`, `ViewVariantInspector` and the operator symbols are untouched. The ` · ` separator and the code spans inside the expression messages also stay literal.
  - No stored value moved. `WIDGET_TYPES[].value` and `onValueChange` still write `picked.value`. The `LOOKUP_OPERATORS` values `eq … notIn` are unchanged, in the same order.
  - `FlowNodeInspector.commitAdvanced` changed from throw-then-catch to `setAdvError` plus `return`. The behaviour is the same, and a JSON parse `SyntaxError` still shows the engine's own text.
- **Locale plumbing: correct.** Every new `locale` parameter is optional.
  - Callers outside `inspectors/`:
    - `previews/flow-expr-problems.ts` calls `validateExpressionClient` with no locale, so it gets en (unchanged).
    - The same file calls `resolveFlowScope` with no locale, but reads only the tokens, not the detail.
    - `previews/flow-region-view.tsx` calls `displayRegionLabel` for the canvas header. `extractRegions` gives `body` the label undefined, so it still returns undefined and no header is drawn.
  - No console or simulator code calls these functions.
  - The new hooks (`useMetadataLocale` in `VariableTextInput`, `useFlowScope` and `FlowExprIssue`) run before any early return, and `locale` is in both `useMemo` dependency lists.
- **zh rows: no real errors.**
  - The chart names match `packages/i18n` `widgetType`: 柱状图 / 条形图 / 折线图 / 面积图 / 饼图 / 环形图 / 漏斗图 / 表格 / 透视表. 属于 / 不属于 / 包含 match its filter `operators`.
  - 组件 matches `engine.inspector.widget.kind`, and 触发记录 and 流程变量 match existing rows.
  - 循环体 is correct: only `loop` has a `body` region.
- **`LOOKUP_OPERATORS` reuse: sound.** `condition.op.{equals,notEquals,greaterThan,lessThan}` are `equals`/`not equals`/`greater than`/`less than`, zh 等于/不等于/大于/小于. They mean the same thing in a lookup or roll-up filter, and the symbol stays outside the word.
- **Pins: real.**
  - The file has 46 cases (21 zh, 20 en, 5 lit), and my count from the source matches.
  - Every zh case reads a rendered attribute or text through the real component, guarded by `zhRow`. The five lit controls are real renders of rows that already existed: a zh `label`, a combobox found by its zh accessible name, the nested-id hint, and the Condition label.
  - One limitation, not blocking: the en cases assert `t(key,'en-US')`, not a literal. At head they are self-referential, so "en unchanged" rests on the one-time keys-only leg and on `check:i18n-drift`. It holds by my independent byte check above.
  - `templateDialect` and `singleBraceTemplate` have no render site, because no caller passes the `template` role, so no pin covers them. Their en bytes match base, as checked above.
- **10696 dated note: form and truth hold, one wording nit.**
  - It follows the objectui#10533 form, the frontmatter is unchanged (the diff only appends), and it is true at head.
  - The nit: "The paragraph above is kept as the reading of this change" points at the `No catalogue row is added…` line, not at the `Body` bullet. Replacement text: "The rest of this entry is kept as the reading of this change; the objectui#10748 entry states what the crumb now does."
- **Changeset: every sentence matches the diff except one imprecision.**
  - "Each now reads a new `engine.*` row" is false for the four reused operator words, and the entry contradicts it two bullets later.
  - Replacement text: "Each now reads an `engine.*` row — a new one, except four lookup-operator words that reuse the condition builder's rows — and each en row carries the English the literal did, so en-US renders the same words:". Not blocking.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` with Clause-② "no" is right.
- The package `exports` has only `.` and `./styles.css`.
- `src/index.ts` exports no symbol from `expression-validate`, `flow-scope`, `useFlowScope` or `flow-region-label`.
- Every added parameter is an optional `locale` string, so it is optional in any case.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI on the head:** 43 check runs.
  - 40 are success: Test, Test shards 1–8, Test (dist pins), Type Check, Lint, Build & E2E, Live E2E, Bundle Analysis, Changeset Declaration/Bump Policy/Fixed Group/Claim Re-read/Overwrite Report, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Control Byte Scan, Line Citation Gate, and the doc/skill checks.
  - 3 are skipped: Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard), dependabot.
  - The Vercel status is success.
- **merge-tree:** all three merges are clean.
  - Against main `c58b8e4a0b`: exit 0, tree `099ad74c48`.
  - Against PR objectui#10792 head `8e4e5982af`: exit 0, tree `38564ee84b` (the same tree the dev reported).
  - Against open PR objectui#10797: exit 0. Its overlap in `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` is comment-only.
- **The union with #10792 type-checks, by reading.** In the merged `FlowExprIssue`, the `useMetadataLocale` hook is called first, `validateExpressionClient(role, value, locale)` gets the locale, and #10792's `flowScopeNote` and `screenNode` branch are intact. #10792's `'screen_fields'` addition to `ScopeGroupId` does not touch this PR's hunks.
- **The union still shows English under zh-CN.** Two new strings from #10792 are not covered by this PR's keys:
  - The `'Screen fields'` group heading (`FlowObjectListField` `screenScopeGroups`). It renders as a `VariableTextInput` heading beside this PR's zh picker words, the same class as `engine.flowScope.group.*`.
  - The screen `visibleWhen` note from `screenVisibleWhenScopeError`: "`X` is not a field on this screen (did you mean `Y`?)", plus its parse-refusal text.
- **The dev report's carriers are not real.**
  - For finding 1 (`FlowExprIssue` `describeUnknownRefs` has no locale) and finding 2 (`flow-expr-problems` `checkCel` / `checkScreenVisibleWhen` has no locale), the report names objectui#10792 as the carrier. But #10792 is frozen in the merge queue, and its head passes no locale in either place.
  - So after both land, the Problems panel shows English for the same expression message the inline cell shows in zh.
  - None of this blocks #10800. It needs ONE follow-up card: the `flowScopeNote` locale, the `flow-expr-problems` locale, and #10792's `Screen fields` heading and screen-scope note. objectui#10748 should not be recorded as closing the whole family.
- **Open PRs touching these files:** only #10792 and #10797. Both merge clean.
- **Governed predicate:** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#10800` exits 0. Result: 0 of 17 paths are governed, and at 1100 lines the PR is under the human-merge threshold.
- **Claim amendment:** done. Claim `5856979487` was edited at 15:59:41Z and now names `previews/flow-region-label.ts` and the 10696 changeset.
- **Draft state:** the PR is a draft (the relay forces this), and the assignee is `os-elon-musk`. It needs the seat to undraft it.
